row.title: airouter all-dropped plan never recovered
row.body: Lifetime pass rates never recovered, so an all-dropped free plan ended 'no model passed ()' forever. Dropped free models are now re-probed (AIROUTER-REPROBE-1). Tick gained age_sla (Q-PARITY-4) and cost_probe (Q-COST-PROOF-2, skipped when degraded).
